items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] TANCIL? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, that's right. It was a nightclub...

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. It was a nightclub and they had a bar. And it was just at the dividing line of Cicero Avenue and Hawthorne. And Cicero is where Capone moved in there. And Capone, it was right next to a race track, the Hawthorne Race Track out in the West Side of Chicago. Near the Western Electric industry there.
